title: MAP clipboard payloads
description: Payloads for display.clipboard.set, display.clipboard.changed and the legacy display.clipboard pull reply. The envelope op selects the semantics; set and changed share the window+text shape. The 4 MiB limit is counted in UTF-8 bytes, which JSON Schema cannot express exactly; maxLength is the code-point upper bound.

windowText.description: display.clipboard.set request and display.clipboard.changed event payload

text.description: UTF-8 clipboard text. Empty text is rejected by display.clipboard.set, and v1 never emits a changed event for an empty selection; changed events over 4 MiB of UTF-8 bytes are discarded as a whole. maxLength counts code points; the normative 4 MiB limit is UTF-8 bytes, enforced at dispatch level.

pullReply.description: Legacy display.clipboard reply: read-only B-compositor selection, no window routing. May be empty.
